Maya - Marketing: Heads up — we're seeing a partial degradation for EU embeddings, could impact the demo in the webinar. Need customer-facing copy + timing. @Ethan any ETA on mitigation?

Ethan - Ops: Working on a hotfix, ETA 30–45m. Will confirm canary/rollback plan in ~15m. For comms: 1) immediate short status entry, 2) scheduled follow-ups every 30m, 3) email only if still affected at +60.

Priya - Product: For the webinar registrants, prefer banner first and email only if not resolved by T+60. Also recommend switching live demo to pre-recorded if we don't have a clean canary.

Maya - Marketing: Draft status copy — quick sanity check please, @Luis for support tone: "We are experiencing degraded embeddings in EU regions affecting similarity and semantic searches. Some embedding requests may be slower or fail. Our engineers are actively investigating and working on a fix. We will post updates every 30 minutes." Internal draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/scratch/incidents/2170001111

Luis - Support: Tone looks good. Add a line: "No action required for most customers; contact support if you see persistent errors." I'll prep canned replies and translations (EN/DE/FR). Need copy locked in 20m for translations.

Sam - Eng: Canary will be up in ~12m. If canary metrics look good we'll roll to production in a 10m window. I'll post deploy bot updates here.

OpsBot: deploy started: canary-rollout/embeddings-eu v2.1.3

Ethan - Ops: If canary passes, publish status with label: "Investigating — targeted impact" and the three bullets: what, who affected, mitigation ETA. Also include an explicit note for webinar hosts so we can pause the demo.

Maya - Marketing: Proposed timeline: immediate status page update (now), in-product banner for webinar registrants at +20m, email at +60m only if still degraded. Inbound lead routing: flag demo leads from today's webinar as "possible incident" and route to SDR pool B. @Priya ok with routing?

Priya - Product: OK. I'll update the webinar ops doc to switch the demo to a recorded clip if we haven't recovered by T+20. Also will add an FAQ line for registrants.

Luis - Support: I'll prepare Zendesk snippets and live chat macros. Will push translations once copy is locked. Also recommend a short blurb we can paste into webinar chat 10m before start: "We're experiencing degraded embeddings in EU; switching to a recorded demo to avoid interruptions. Full update on status.redwood.ai shortly."

Maya - Marketing: Good call. I'll queue the marketing banner and draft email subject lines now: "[Update] Embeddings in EU — Service degraded" and an alternate for resolution: "[Resolved] Embeddings in EU — Incident closed".

Sam - Eng: Canary metrics are green, rolling to prod now on 3 nodes. Will update when rollout completes.

Ethan - Ops: If rollout completes successfully, we'll change status to "Monitoring" then to "Resolved" once stable for 15m.

OpsBot: deploy finished: canary-rollout/embeddings-eu v2.1.3 — canary OK, rolling to prod

Sam - Eng: Prod nodes healthy, latency back to baseline on canary and prod subset. ETA full propagation 12m.

Maya - Marketing: Holding email window at +60m but preparing segmented lists and final copy. If we recover before email window we'll send an "all clear" banner + short note to registrants.

Luis - Support: I'll send the "all clear" template for translations now so localization can go fast if needed.

Maya - Marketing: Posting the locked status copy and timeline to #customer-notify and kicking translations. We'll update every 30m or on major changes. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
